# Kandelo changelog

What you can build, run, and do with Kandelo. Each dated update collects
highlights, improvements, and compatibility notes.

## 2026.11.10 — Debug, measure and explore your browser computer

Rust development now includes source debugging and coverage reporting,
while searchable manuals and system logs help you explore the computer
and diagnose the software running inside it.

This survey covers changes on `develop` through the source commit below.
They reach stable `main` through the project's tested-promotion process;
landing on `develop` alone is not a full runtime-validation claim.

### Highlights

- **Stop a Rust program at a source line.** Development-checkout commands
  set breakpoints, step over calls and show the stack in a Node or headless
  Chromium guest. Rust local-variable inspection and Firefox/WebKit
  interactive stepping are not implemented.
  [Use the source debugger](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/rust-debugging.md).
- **Measure Rust code coverage inside Kandelo.** The guest SDK includes
  matching profiler support, `llvm-profdata` and `llvm-cov`. Build and run
  an offline Cargo project, merge the profiles, and generate text or HTML
  coverage reports in the same computer.
  [Collect coverage](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/rust-debugging.md#coverage-inside-kandelo).
- **Find help without leaving the terminal.** More packaged tools bring
  their manuals, including the Rust tools, Git, curl, wget, Perl, ffmpeg
  and desktop programs. Use `man` to read installed pages, `whatis` to look
  up a command, and `apropos` or `man -k` to search the manual index.
  [Manuals and search](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/porting-guide.md#the-man-page-index).
- **Ask the computer what went wrong.** `dmesg` exposes the kernel log,
  including missing syscalls a ported program tries to use. Images running
  the new syslog service collect `logger` and application messages in
  `/var/log/messages`.
  [System-log change and its validation scope](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1648).

### Breaking Changes & Migration

- **Rebuild the kernel and host together.** The kernel/host interface is
  now version 6; program ABI remains 56. The `klogctl` interface uses an
  explicit program extension, required only by programs that call it.
  Saved-computer upgrade restrictions still apply.
  [Kernel-log extension](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/program-extensions.md#kernel-log-version-1).

### Agentic Workflows

- **Give an agent more ways to investigate Rust code.** The installed
  Rust SDK can produce coverage reports and source-aware backtraces
  alongside its Cargo build/test workflows. The interactive source debugger
  is a separate development-checkout command using Node or Chromium;
  it does not attach to an existing shared browser computer.
  [Rust development tools](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/rust-debugging.md).

### Ports & Packages

- **Read the manuals for the tools you are using.** Lazy documentation
  archives extend coverage across compiler tools, shells, text utilities,
  network clients and desktop programs. The generated manual index makes
  installed pages searchable. Packages without usable upstream pages use
  the documented alternative sources where available; some Kandelo wrappers
  still have no manual page.
  [Manual sourcing and remaining gaps](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/porting-guide.md#shipping-man-pages).
- **Fetch game launchers when you use them.** DOS and retro-console launcher
  scripts now follow the shell's lazy-loading path, alongside the existing
  on-demand engines and game data. The activities remain discoverable
  before those files are fetched.
  [Lazy game launchers](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1675).

### Correctness

- **Run another Bash command after Ctrl-C.** Fork continuation handling
  fixes a case where interrupting a blocked command left later commands
  hanging. Regression cases cover interrupted sleep and catch-handler
  replay.
  [Shell interruption fix](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1688).
- **Keep saved deletions and directory listings consistent.** Persistent
  compaction preserves image-entry removals when a directory is deleted;
  rootfs directory positions also stay coherent while entries change.
  [Compaction fix](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/bd15db6cc3),
  [directory iteration fix](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/a4a6e6e6a7).
- **See coherent filesystem information in `df`.** Filesystem reporting
  now describes the mounted filesystems consistently.
  [Filesystem reporting](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1683).
- **Make Cargo notice an installed SDK change.** Compiler-cache and build
  identities include the actual SDK components, so replacing the toolchain
  invalidates stale results. Complete replacement with saved Cargo caches
  is validated on Node; browser replacement still fails during extraction
  with `ENOSPC`. Normal builds and same-SDK cache reuse remain a separate,
  documented workflow.
  [SDK identity and upgrade boundary](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/rust-target.md#cargo-inside-kandelo).

### POSIX Completeness

- **Let programs log through ordinary Unix sockets.** Cross-process
  AF_UNIX datagrams and binding `/dev/log` allow `syslog(3)` messages to
  reach a daemon in another guest process. The kernel log is readable
  independently through `/dev/kmsg`, so readers can follow it concurrently.
  The landed change records focused Node validation; full browser and
  conformance coverage remain follow-up work.
  [Logging support and evidence](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1648).

### New Capabilities

- **Get source context for Rust failures.** Captured backtraces retain
  their own symbol data, even after another capture or a thread exit.
  Node, Chromium and Firefox resolve recorded user source lines; the
  tested WebKit engine supplies names without instruction offsets, so its
  backtraces lack source lines.
  [Rust backtraces](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037/docs/rust-target.md#source-diagnostics-and-backtraces).

[Source](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037) · [Full diff](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/compare/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e...39d7a84a53e2dfa4f693e803ff4a08033a743037) · Program ABI **56** · Kernel/host **6**

## 2026.11.08 — Build with an agent in a browser OS

An agent can edit source, run installed compilers and tests, and inspect
results in the same browser computer you use. WebMCP connects the agent
to Kandelo's commands, files, terminals, and previews. Development commands
run inside the guest OS, using its files and processes.

The computer also runs its own C/C++ and experimental Rust development
tools. Write a program, compile it, run it, and test it in one environment;
the compilers themselves run as Kandelo programs.

This first update collects milestones from March–November 2026.

### Highlights

- **Give an agent a development computer in your browser.** WebMCP lets
  an agent edit files, run installed development tools, and inspect results
  alongside you in the same computer. Requires a browser with WebMCP
  registration support.
  [Explore the agent tools](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/webmcp.md).
- **Compile C, C++ and Rust inside your browser computer.** The Base Shell
  runs `cc` and `c++`; the experimental Rust environment adds Cargo builds
  and tests, formatting, Clippy, and documentation, including projects with
  C/C++ build scripts.
  [Try C/C++](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/sdk-guide.md#compile-inside-the-base-shell),
  [Set up the experimental Rust environment](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/rust-target.md#cargo-inside-kandelo).
- **Revisit DOS, adventure and console games.** DOSBox Pure runs DOS games;
  ScummVM brings classic adventures; FCEUmm, Snes9x and Genesis Plus GX cover
  NES, SNES, Mega Drive/Genesis, Master System and Game Gear software.
  [DOS games and importing your own](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/dosbox-pure/README.md),
  [available game activities](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/shell/source-rootfs-shell-demo-profiles.json).
- **Share a running web app or WordPress site with someone else.** A network
  invitation lets another Kandelo computer browse the server running on
  yours. Posts, form submissions and files stay on the hosting computer;
  participants use the same running application.
  [Share websites over a session](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/package-sessions.md#forms-and-launches).
- **Play DOOM, Quake and Freeciv together.** Network sessions connect guest
  computers for cooperative or deathmatch DOOM, Quake multiplayer, and
  Freeciv strategy games with a shared lobby.
  [Start a network session](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs-site/guide/current-ui.md#network-sessions).

### Breaking Changes & Migration

- **Export important files before updating Kandelo.** Browser computers
  retain files in browser storage, but saved computers from this release
  will not work in the next release. Transactional software upgrades are
  not available yet.
  See the [persistence and compatibility contract](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/persistent-program-compatibility.md).
- **Rebuild programs compiled for ABI 55 or earlier.** The declared supported
  program baseline is ABI 56. Program compatibility and the kernel/host
  interface now have separate version counters; saved-computer upgrades
  remain a separate capability.
  See [compatibility admission](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/persistent-program-compatibility.md#what-a-narrow-program-contract-actually-contains).

### User Interface

- **Keep a computer and come back to your work.** The Library creates and
  reopens computers from Base Shell, Web Stack, and WordPress images.
  Image-backed files persist; scratch files such as `/tmp` reset on reboot.
  The update limitation above still applies.
  [Computer UI milestone](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/a1f844271860729a4806898c56bc6950aa20b558).
- **Open another app without rebooting.** Activities launch installed apps
  on your running computer, sharing its files and processes. Switch between
  terminals, web previews, and graphics while their programs keep running;
  an activity stops a conflicting display or managed web activity first.
  [Browser guide](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs-site/guide/current-ui.md).
- **Invite someone into your running website.** The network panel can share
  WordPress, the Web Stack, and supported Python/PHP/Ruby web apps. Joining
  opens the host's existing server in the participant's preview. The host
  keeps the application and its data running; leaving the room disconnects
  the shared preview. WordPress images can also offer an interactive SQL
  connection to their MariaDB database.
  [Website and database sessions](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/package-sessions.md).
  Sessions need signalling and a working peer connection; the documented
  default has no TURN relay. This shares a live service while connected.
- **Send someone a starting point they can change.** Share-setup links can
  carry startup settings and an optional shell script. The script runs when
  the recipient opens the link, is printed in the terminal, and remains
  available to inspect, edit and run again. These links carry setup, rather
  than copying a saved computer's disk.
  [Script-carrying share links](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs-site/guide/current-ui.md#script-carrying-share-links).

### Agentic Workflows

- **Build software together in a guest OS sandbox.** Through WebMCP, an
  agent can edit source, invoke the installed compilers and development
  tools, manage command jobs, and inspect results in shared terminals and
  previews. Commands run inside Kandelo's guest OS with the agent account's
  permissions. Browser-origin isolation is a separate boundary: same-origin
  preview scripts share the app's WebMCP trust boundary. Registration requires
  `document.modelContext.registerTool`; capability availability is reported
  by the running environment.
  [WebMCP contract](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/webmcp.md).
- **Teach the agent what your environment can do.** Images and the guest's
  `maker` account can declare additional tools in files. Editing a definition
  refreshes the tool without reloading the computer. Commands run as jobs
  owned by the agent account, with bounded output and cancellation.
  [Image-declared tools](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/webmcp.md#image-declared-tools).
- **Resume development work across agent sessions.** Contributor tools
  retain long-job evidence and checkpoint campaign state across sessions.
  [Campaign guidance](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/agent-guidance/campaigns.md).
- **Integrate reviewed work while preserving local changes.** Contributor
  tools record pinned source and patch identities and journal imported
  validation evidence.
  [Integration workflow](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/agent-integration.md).

### Ports & Packages

- **Play DOS games through DOSBox Pure.** The Base Shell's DOS games
  activity can fetch Commander Keen 1 shareware, DOS Defender, vitetris,
  and Anarch on demand. `dos-play --list` shows the catalog; you can also
  drop your own DOS game ZIP into the computer. The x86 CPU is interpreted,
  with graphics, keyboard/mouse input and sound through Kandelo devices.
  Commercial game data is supplied by the user.
  [DOSBox Pure usage and limits](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/dosbox-pure/README.md).
- **Return to classic adventures with ScummVM.** Its game activity can
  fetch freeware releases such as *Beneath a Steel Sky* and *Flight of the
  Amazon Queen*, or load your own supported game data. ScummVM runs through
  Kandelo's SDL2 graphics, audio and input stack. Engine availability is
  specific to this build; the activity marks unsupported catalog entries.
  [ScummVM activity and game choices](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/shell/source-rootfs-shell-demo-profiles.json#L263),
  [freeware catalog](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/shell/scummvm-freeware-games.json).
- **Drop a console ROM into your browser computer.** The retro-emulator
  activities use FCEUmm for NES, Snes9x for SNES, and Genesis Plus GX for
  Mega Drive/Genesis, Master System and Game Gear. Each core is a Kandelo
  program with framebuffer output, audio and keyboard-as-joypad input.
  Freely redistributable test ROMs provide starter content; bring your own
  compatible game ROMs.
  [Retro emulator port](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1637),
  [cores and included content](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/retro-emulators/package.toml).
- **Build a civilization in Freeciv.** The SDL2 client and dedicated
  server run inside Kandelo with their rulesets, tilesets and audio data.
  Play locally or host a TCP multiplayer game through a network session;
  players choose nations, maps and settings in Freeciv's own lobby.
  [Play and host Freeciv](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/freeciv.md#multiplayer).
- **Play DOOM with graphics, sound and music.** The fbDOOM port uses the
  guest framebuffer and audio devices. Network sessions provide cooperative
  and deathmatch games, with a waiting room before the host starts play.
  Game data choices and matching files are handled by the activity setup.
  [DOOM game options](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/fbdoom/sessions.json).
- **Host a Quake game from a browser computer.** TyrQuake brings Quake's
  software renderer, audio and ordinary multiplayer menus to Kandelo.
  Network sessions connect the players' computers; use the activity setup
  to choose compatible game data and a level.
  [Quake hosting and joining](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/tyrquake/sessions.json).
- **Run Lua games with LÖVE.** The port combines Lua with SDL2/GLES graphics,
  audio and mouse input. Its package guide describes supported controls
  and current graphics limits.
  [LÖVE on Kandelo](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/registry/love/README.md).
- **Run a WordPress site inside a browser tab.** WordPress runs on nginx
  and PHP-FPM with SQLite or MariaDB. The Web Stack also offers Python
  Notes, Ruby Todo and a Redis voting board: the web servers and databases
  are programs inside the Kandelo computer.
  [Web applications](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs-site/guide/current-ui.md#computers-and-activities),
  [package catalog](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/README.md).
- **Build and run C and C++ in the Base Shell.** The `cc` and `c++` commands
  fetch their compiler tools on first use. Source code, compiler processes,
  and the resulting programs all live in the Kandelo computer.
  [SDK guide](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/sdk-guide.md),
  [C/C++ example](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/README.md#build-c-and-c-inside-kandelo).
- **Build Rust projects, including code that calls C and C++.** The
  experimental guest toolchain includes rustc, Cargo, a matching standard
  library, rustfmt, Clippy, and rustdoc. Cargo can compile native dependencies
  through `build.rs` and run unit, integration, and documentation tests.
  Start with the documented development image or optional SDK bundle and
  its offline, single-job build workflow. Procedural-macro
  crates are currently unsupported; arbitrary third-party crates and HTTPS
  registry access are not established by that coverage.
  [Rust inside Kandelo](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/rust-target.md#cargo-inside-kandelo).
- **Keep a development toolbox beside your code.** Git, Vim, nano and tmux
  provide terminal workflows; Python, Ruby, Perl, PHP and Composer cover
  scripting and web development. A SpiderMonkey-based Node.js-compatible
  runtime brings JavaScript and npm workflows, and NetHack adds a terminal
  game alongside the graphical ports.
  [Software examples](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/packages/README.md).

### Correctness

- **Make shells and subprocesses agree about what is happening.** Work on
  process waits, signal interruption, file locks, and blocking I/O moves
  state and wakeup decisions into the shared kernel. These changes apply
  to both Node.js and browser hosts; remaining partial interfaces stay
  documented.
  [POSIX status](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/posix-status.md).
- **Address memory retained when switching computers.** Filesystem images
  are composed in disposable workers, and teardown has explicit ownership
  rules for shared memory. Persistent device realms stay separate from
  guest process memory.
  [Host runtime contract](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/agent-guidance/host-runtime.md).

### POSIX Completeness

- **Run programs that start other programs and work together.** The platform
  covers multi-process execution, pipes, terminals, signals, sockets,
  threads, and dynamic linking. POSIX conformance remains
  the goal; the status tables distinguish full, partial, unsupported, and
  planned behavior.
  [Interface status](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/posix-status.md).
- **Use tmux and software built on libevent.** Expanded epoll support enabled
  those ports. Multicast routing also lets networked programs communicate
  across Kandelo machines.
  [epoll milestone](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/d51ac6d2ce),
  [multicast milestone](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/32a221cb7c).

### New Capabilities

- **Run the same platform in a browser or Node.js.** Kandelo grew from its
  initial kernel and host into a multi-process environment, with package
  resolution and filesystem image tooling shared across the two hosts.
  [Architecture](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/architecture.md).
- **Try a new port without building every package.** Partial images compose
  a root filesystem with your selected packages. Canonical products remain
  the publication and broad-validation path.
  [Partial image workflow](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/f762afc103).
- **Run desktop applications in a browser computer.** Graphics work brings
  a Wayland desktop, the Cage/Sway foundation, and a guest graphics driver.
  Cage startup on WebKit remains a known defect, and broader graphics
  conformance is unfinished.
  [Compositor foundation](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/pull/1594),
  [graphics compatibility](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/blob/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e/docs/graphics/compatibility-v1.md).

[Source](https://github.com/Automattic/kandelo/commit/df8cf7461f23a6d11d4250aadd3c4ddd4789e81e) · Program ABI **56** · Kernel/host **4**
